payload.name: Lateral Reading
payload.fact: Lateral reading, defined as consulting multiple external sources, significantly improves the accuracy of detecting health-related misinformation compared to vertical reading.

provenance.title: Fact-Checking Strategies in Web: Lateral Navigation in the Browser Boosts Health Misinformation Detection Even Under Confirmation Bias
provenance.quote_or_locus: we find that lateral reading significantly improves accuracy (β = 0.09, 95% CI [0.079, 0.181], p = 0.001), while vertical reading has no effect (β = -0.01, p = 0.332
